name: Yamaraj's Grandeur
text:
Frequency once per day

---
You have been granted a sliver of the power of the yamaraj, the magistrates of the dead who agreed to allow duskwalkers to exist at all. You exhale a blast of icy wind and ravenous insects. This is a 30-foot cone that deals 14d6 slashing,4d6 persistent,slashing damage (basic Reflex save save using your class or spell DC, whichever is higher). On a critical failure, targets also become Sickened 2.
